findings.desc: Wrapper-root DONE can false-block before the wrapper-aware DONE oracle. transition-orchestrator resolves doneGitCwd for DONE and passes it to runDonePreMergeGate/buildDoneChecklist, where the new review-assurance-floor row calls evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor with gitCwd. But actor.can() runs first in transition-orchestrator, and machine.canFinishGuard/getGuardFailureReason call evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor with only projectRoot. In wrapper-root layouts where metadataRoot != gitRoot, evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor falls back to gitCwd=projectRoot, so git diff main...HEAD/currentMaterialHash run from the non-git metadata root and return floor.ok=false. Result: the machine can reject TEST→DONE before the DONE oracle row that has the resolved gitCwd can pass, breaking DONE oracle vs machine.canFinish consistency and wrapper-root behavior. Existing new smoke only exercises the evaluator directly and does not cover the actor guard path. Source refs: packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:343, packages/main/src/handlers/transition-orchestrator.ts:391, packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:431, packages/main/src/core/machine.ts:870, packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:258, packages/main/src/core/done-oracle.ts:745.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3b6a2682b by threading resolved DONE gitCwd into machine canFinish actor context and resolving gitCwd inside getGuardFailureReason fallback; regression covered by review-assurance-floor smoke 'wrapper-root machine DONE guard uses resolved gitCwd'. Verified: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; lattice validate --story=B-ed99.

findings.desc: Accepted Review Assurance Floor says high-risk lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact work keeps the stronger 3x2 or explicit degraded-single-host path (docs/requirements/decisions/review-assurance-floor-execution-plan.md:10,62,70,79), but evaluateReviewAssuranceFloor only chooses one-local-round vs three-local-rounds from failureSignals and never reads story riskSignals/priority/touchpoints (packages/main/src/core/review-assurance-floor.ts:324-329). Existing review escalation only requires 3x2 after the first REVIEW round has >=2 countable problems (packages/main/src/core/review-escalation.ts:225-229), so a high-risk gate/process-fact material code change with no failure signal can satisfy DONE with one local round. That undercuts the accepted concept rather than preserving the stronger-review boundary for high-risk local non-authority evidence.
findings.resolvedReason: Fixed in commit 3b6a2682b by adding high-risk lifecycle/gate/Authority/process-fact review assurance floor semantics: 3 rounds x 2 independent local hosts, or explicit degraded-single-host fallback bound to current material; ordinary clean material code remains one local round and failure signals remain sticky 3x1 unless high-risk applies. Local evidence continues to report authorityDone=false, fullAuthorityDone=false, productionDone=false. Verified: npm run build; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-assurance-floor-smoke.js; node packages/main/dist/tasks/review-escalation-smoke.js; node scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; lattice validate --story=B-ed99.
